title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 94. Expresses grave concern about the serious allegations of fraud and irregularities involving the College of Europe and the EEAS in the tender procedure for the European Diplomatic Academy; welcomes the resignation of Federica Mogherini and the retirement of Stefano Sannino; believes, in view of the ongoing investigations, that the College of Europe should cease the operations of the European Diplomatic Academy until full clarity, accountability and transparency are ensured;
